query:
UPDATE outbox o
              SET attempts     = o.attempts + 1,
                  last_error   = f.err,
                  locked_by    = NULL,
                  locked_until = NULL,
                  available_at = now() + (f.delay_ms * interval '1 millisecond'),
                  updated_at   = now()
             FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::text[], $3::bigint[]) AS f(id, err, delay_ms)
            WHERE o.id = f.id AND o.locked_by = $4
